cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hand It Over
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take over that hinge. The cupboard door is lower than when you started; I know how to hold it level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still finding the right screw.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep choosing it. I'll manage the door while you do. Pass me the screwdriver, when you're ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you'll tell everyone you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can tell them you directed the repair. That's a sound division of work. I'll be the one holding it level and tightening your chosen screw. May I have the tool?

reason: Have A present a confident repair plan but accept subordinate public credit and B timing to gain actual tool control.
